purpose: Two attributed customer quotes, a six-logo customer strip and the G2 rating.
geometry: section height 1180.84 @1280; padding pt-[15em] pb-[10em] — NOT the 18em/5em of every other dark section

motion.RULE: QUOTE_LEAVES are STATIC BY DESIGN (initial === animate, no class). A contract MUST FORBID animating them.

responsive.max-wf-tablet: the pair wraps; card 2 gains mt-[14.4em] mb-[5em]; the logo strip becomes a 56em flex-wrap row with no left padding
responsive.max-wf-mini: cards scale down via text-[0.8em]; the strip centres

complianceNote: REAL quotes from REAL named people at REAL named companies, with their REAL photographs. A generator must never invent a testimonial or a person, and must never attach an existing portrait to a new quote.
dedupeNote: src/components/socialProofB.jsx used to hold its own byte-identical copies of all three blocks, because the /referral and /pricing extractions ran in parallel. It is now a thin DATA ADAPTER over the shared components, keeping its export names.
